summary: Feature release after 1.2.1: opt-in persistent browser logs with structured logging, encrypted PDF previews behind the Edge feature flag, Shared Drive bulk actions without a feature flag, MLS and calling fixes, and the backup export working again. The Helm chart does not change; nothing to do before upgrading.

changes.description: Browser logs can be kept on the device: opt-in startup toggle, structured JSON logging with Pino, rotation and retention aligned with Wire Desktop, processing in a dedicated worker.
Encrypted PDF previews and thumbnails in conversations, behind the Edge feature flag (WPB-29908).
Shared Drive bulk actions are no longer behind a feature flag; bulk restore stays behind one; bulk archive download in the API client (WPB-29892, WPB-29920, WPB-29939, WPB-29960).
MLS: epoch recovery when message buffering lasts too long, buffered messages keep their authors, malformed buffered messages are isolated, stale conference joins are retried with backoff.
Calls: AVS 10.5.24, the call security line feature is released, no missed-call message when the call was answered on another device, meeting reminders are silent while the status is away.
Mark as unread is back, with the manual unread state kept locally.
Server: gzip and deflate response compression, the bundled server is the production deployment artifact, Node 26.13.1.
Backup export works again (libsodium-sumo pinned to 0.7.15, WPB-29974).
Local data is kept when the local client cannot be loaded; federated E2EI identities are separated by domain and stale X509 key packages are removed on renewal.
